text: Bitcoin and Ethereum are both posting solid gains, with Ethereum outpacing Bitcoin slightly at 5.6% versus 4.6%, suggesting buyers are rotating into altcoin exposure rather than purely defensive positioning. The Fear & Greed index at 71 (Greed) and climbing 8 points over a week indicates sustained optimism, though Bitcoin dominance holding firm at 58.4% shows the rally remains anchored to the larger cap assets. Volume at $128B reflects healthy participation, with no signs of thin liquidity driving the moves.
